now.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
now.text: Erik Killmonger is a cousin of T'Challa, Toussaint's father, which makes him Toussaint's first cousin once removed. Erik dies in his fight for the throne before Toussaint is born.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Son of Killmonger's cousin T'Challa, born after Killmonger dies.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Toussaint's father's cousin, who died before he was born.

changes.evidence: A blood tie never met. Killmonger dies in Black Panther (2016 in-story); Toussaint (T'Challa II) is T'Challa and Nakia's son, raised in secret in Haiti and seen only in the Wakanda Forever mid-credits scene. The stage text itself says Erik dies before Toussaint is born; nothing on screen shows or implies they know each other, and Erik's actions have no direct consequence for Toussaint.

owner_calls.question: Keep Jasper Sitwell and Emil Blonsky? They never meet (the stage text says so): in The Consultant, Sitwell and Coulson only discuss Blonsky and plot to send a patsy (Tony) so Ross refuses to release him. Drop as knowing ABOUT someone, or keep under the huge-consequences exception (the plot keeps Blonsky in prison and off the Avengers Initiative)?
owner_calls.evidence: MCU wiki: Sitwell and Coulson both knew about Blonsky and hatched a plan to avoid his liberation; Coulson sends Tony Stark to annoy Ross. Blonsky does not appear with Sitwell.
